title: Current qualification and delivery state
summary: Current executable grounding is Legal Effect v0.14, Institutional Policy v0.8, Intention Service v0.1-dev11 and Legal Interrogation v0.1-dev6. Dev6 is qualified under the exact Library ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 runtime against the exact sibling Intention Service, Legal Effect, Alchemy Objects and Crypto archives, and is published directly to Git because Autobuilder is not running.
invariants: Legal Effect v0.14 is the accepted legal runtime baseline and continues to expose public API legal.effect/0.10.
Intention Service dev11 is the dynamic-discovery baseline used by the Legal Interrogation adapter.
Legal Interrogation dev6 passed the complete r13196 suite including live Intention Service dev11 and real LegalRuleCompiler integration.
Direct Git publication while Autobuilder is stopped is delivery evidence; runtime qualification comes from the recorded exact local execution inputs and transcript, not from the transport mechanism.
Legal Interrogation source verification and compiler certification remain Legal Effect authority operations even though dev6 supplies the concrete bridge.

provenance.claim: Legal Effect v0.14 is the accepted runtime baseline used by this sphere.
Intention Service dev11 owns CLARIFY/CONFIRM/READY resolution and discovery refresh/replacement semantics.
Dev6 records PASS under exact ooRexx r13196 with real Intention Service dev11 and real Legal Effect v0.14 compiler integration.
Live qualification reaches the real compiler certification/publicationEligible boundary and rejects asserted-only verification.
